Subject: Post-call recap & proposed next steps (Acme Retail)

Hi Sofia — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our discovery and a few suggested next steps so we stay aligned. Attaching the short notes and the demo deck.

Key takeaways:
- Primary goal: reduce search-recommendation latency on peak traffic by ~40% while keeping relevance quality steady.
- Constraints: on-prem VPC for sensitive PII, strict SLA window 99.9% during peak hours, and monthly cost target (TCO) for pilot.
- Stakeholders: you (product), Cloud Ops (cc), and Eng lead for pilot (likely head of infra).

Suggested next steps:
1) I can share a ballpark pilot cost and config now (3-week pilot on dedicated capacity).
2) Tech deep-dive with Dev to map network/KMS constraints (30–45 min).
3) Pilot kickoff / timeline if we align on scope.

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive (PT):
- Wed 7/21 10:00–10:45am
- Thu 7/22 2:00–2:45pm
- Tue 7/27 9:30–10:15am

Can you confirm which works, and whether you want the ballpark cost before we lock a slot?

Attachments: 20260714-acme-discovery-notes.pdf, redwood-demo-overview.pptx

Thanks — happy to adjust.

—Marissa

Also, I won't be able to set up a deep-dive this week — early August is safer for our calendar. Can you send the ballpark and we'll circle back the first week of Aug to book the Eng session?

Subject: Ballpark pilot estimate + tech notes (Acme Retail)

Hi Sofia — per your ask, attaching a concise ballpark for the 3-week pilot and a short note on what the dedicated capacity configuration typically looks like given your constraints. Numbers are intentionally a range to reflect options (baseline vs optimized).

Ballpark (3-week pilot, Dedicated GPU pool, VPC + KMS):
- Baseline config (1x A100-equivalent): $18k–$24k
- Optimized config (2x with autoscaling for peak): $30k–$45k
- Typical add-ons: extended logs retention, private control plane — each priced separately (we can itemize if useful).

What this buys: end-to-end latency profiling, a model variant tuned to your tail-latency SLOs, and a migration runbook so your infra team can validate network/KMS flows.

If any of those ranges look like they might fit your internal guardrails, we can lock a 30–45 min technical session with Dev in the first week of August (he's looped). Proposed slots: Tue 8/3 9:00am PT or Wed 8/4 11:00am PT.

If you'd rather I pause outreach and surface this in your procurement review, say the word — happy either way.

—Marissa
(On behalf of Redwood Inference)

Subject: Closing the loop — should I book, pause, or close the file?

Hi Sofia — hope you're well. I wanted to close the loop on our pilot conversation so we don't keep pinging you unnecessarily. Options:

1) Book: we schedule the technical deep-dive (I'll send a calendar invite)
2) Pause: we'll hold the proposal and resume outreach in 4–6 weeks
3) Close: we'll archive the opportunity — easy to reopen later if priorities change

If none of the above, a one-line reply with your preferred option is perfect.

For quick reference, the ballpark ranges I shared are: Baseline $18k–$24k; Optimized $30k–$45k.

Thanks for the time so far — and if it's helpful, I can loop in an engineering case study from a similar retail customer who improved tail latency by ~35% without retraining.

—Marissa
